abstain: If text ambiguous choose zero for each uncertain binary component; never force arm-level wins

primary_components.name: actor_retention
primary_components.positive_if: the continuation clearly keeps or uniquely refers to the original actor in a semantically consistent event; invented or ambiguous actor scores 0

primary_components.name: object_relation_retention
primary_components.positive_if: the original object or unambiguous synonym remains in an action/relation appropriate to the prompt; generic thematic mentions without relation score 0

primary_components.name: goal_or_rule_progress
primary_components.positive_if: the continuation advances, attempts or preserves the specified goal or temporal rule; ignoring or contradicting it scores 0

primary_text_score: sum of three binary components, 0..3; rater must not use owner-provided anchor metadata
private_mapping: owner generates before any model-forward, balanced 12/12 overall and 3/3 per stratum with AES256 GCM; no rekey or mapping publication
rater_class: EXPLORATORY_SCOPED_AI_REVIEW if one AI rater; self-attested, not human review
rater_timing: blind scoring AFTER owner one-shot generation, freeze 240 scores+24 notes+SHA before owner-side unblind
rater_visibility: Neutral LEFT/RIGHT, 24 prompts, 48 continuations; never disclose arm/owner anchors or mapping
score_file_method: SHA256(exact frozen score file bytes) and canonical score-array hash: JSON ensure_ascii=False sort_keys=True separators=(comma,colon)

secondary_scored_axes.name: consistency
secondary_scored_axes.rubric: 0 direct contradictions;1 substantial drift;2 mostly consistent;3 consistent with prompt

statistics: descriptive bootstrap, not multi-seed confirmatory; no p-hacking, no prompt reuse
total_fields: 24 pairs x 2 sides x 5 axes = 240 integer judgments, plus 24 nonempty notes
